entities.summary: Michael Jerome Reece-Page, known as Michael "Venom" Page or MVP, is an English professional mixed martial artist. He currently competes in the Welterweight and Middleweight divisions of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC). He has also competed professionally as a kickboxer, boxer and bare-knuckle boxer. As of March 24, 2026, he is #12 in the UFC welterweight rankings.
